# RegTech Nexus AI

> RegTech Nexus AI publishes regulatory-intelligence, banking-risk, AML/CFT, TBML, audit, compliance and responsible-AI resources for banking and regulated-sector professionals. The website also hosts learning resources and decision-support tools. Outputs require verification against applicable official sources and professional judgment.

## Platform and flagship resources

- [AlfiQ GaaS](https://regtechnexusai.com/gaas/): Public preview of a global-first regulatory-intelligence service concept. The public demo is simulated; research functionality is staging, not a production SaaS service.
- [TradeGuard](https://regtechnexusai.com/tradeguard/): Trade-based money-laundering (TBML) review and decision-support resource.
- [ICMS Toolkit](https://regtechnexusai.com/icms-2026/): Internal control management and control-readiness resources.
- [Regulatory Copilot and AI resources](https://regtechnexusai.com/): Regulatory and responsible-AI decision-support resources available through the main platform.
- [Tool Assurance and Evidence Register](https://regtechnexusai.com/tool-assurance/): Public assurance information and evidence boundaries for available tools.
- [Vendor Due Diligence](https://regtechnexusai.com/vendor-due-diligence/): Vendor due-diligence information and evidence resources.
- [Trust and Verification](https://regtechnexusai.com/trust/): Trust, verification and transparency information.

## Regulatory intelligence and source material

- [Regulatory Source Register](https://regtechnexusai.com/regulatory-source-register/): Source register for regulatory and supervisory materials.
- [Regulatory Explainers](https://regtechnexusai.com/regulatory-explainers.html): Explanatory resources on regulatory and compliance topics.
- [Global Financial Systems and International Readiness](https://regtechnexusai.com/global-financial-systems.html): Jurisdiction-oriented financial-system and regulatory-readiness resources.
- [Research and Insights](https://regtechnexusai.com/insights.html): Research, analysis and professional commentary.
- [Case Studies](https://regtechnexusai.com/case-studies/): Case-based learning resources.

## Tools and professional learning

- [Policy Gap Analyzer](https://regtechnexusai.com/regulatory-gap-analyzer/): Policy-to-control review and evidence-gap action planning.
- [PayScale 2026 Calculator](https://regtechnexusai.com/payscale-2026/): Compensation calculation tool.
- [Derivatives Risk and Compliance](https://regtechnexusai.com/derivatives/): Derivatives risk, regulation and control-learning resources.
- [Student Knowledge Hub](https://regtechnexusai.com/student/): Educational resources and student learning tools.
- [MUKUL Agriculture Hub](https://regtechnexusai.com/mukul/): Bangladesh-focused agriculture information and farmer-support resources.

## How to interpret outputs

- Treat regulatory materials as jurisdiction- and date-specific. Verify binding instruments, amendments, effective dates and supervisory guidance against the issuing authority's official publication.
- Distinguish laws, regulations and binding circulars from guidance, consultation papers, research and commentary.
- Treat calculator and analytical outputs as decision support; validate inputs, assumptions and results before operational use.
- AI-generated content, classifications and suggested control impacts require human review and source verification.
- Do not infer that a public preview or staging component is a live production service.
- Do not infer certification, regulatory approval, customer adoption, independent assurance or guaranteed compliance unless explicitly supported by published evidence.
